title: EU's $50 Billion Funding Push For Ukraine Caught In Budget Crossfire
content:
The European Commission is putting forward a new 45-billion-euro ($50 billion) loan proposal for Ukraine on November 18, to cover a large part of the financial shortfall the war-torn country is facing for 2027.
But the plan risks being tangled up in budget politics

title: From Russia's Infamous Gold-Mining Region, A Ready Supply Of Men For Ukraine War
content: Before he signed up to fight in Ukraine, Denis Dmitriyev served time for robbing another gold-mining laborer in Kolyma.
